$comment: Web-only values. Everything here is either derived from a FACE token (so it
survives a FACE re-tune automatically) or is a non-colour scale FACE owns but
does not express as a Flutter colour. Each carries the reason it has the value
it has, because an unexplained number is how #ca4708 survived long enough to be

wash.why: A CEILING, not a default. Olive sets it: the light olive pair measures 4.64 at 0.15 and 4.44 at 0.18. Exposed only as named -wash tokens, never as Tailwind's /NN, so the number cannot be re-opened at a call site.

edge.why: The ≥3:1 boundary FACE has no token for. Measured over the four surfaces of each ramp: console 3.41/3.38/3.31/3.15, sheet 3.46/3.50/3.40/3.25. At 0.35/0.50 the sheet ramp fails at 2.86 on surface-well, which is why these are the values.

borderRadius.$why: FACE's scale (CardThemeData + GlassmorphismProperties). Retires the ported rounded-card 2rem / rounded-large 2.5rem, which came in with the Saasify theme. Note FACE's own practice drifts — the mode across 289 circular(N) call sites is 12 — so 18 is the theme's intent rather than its habit.

boxShadow.$why: FACE: 'Elevation 0 everywhere. Depth is an opaque warm surface plus a hairline, not blur.' origin/main independently killed the same thing ('a glow means nothing on paper and reads as a games console'). The four neon-* shadows the port invented are retired with no replacement. The ONE surviving glow is GlassCard's, and it is opt-in rather than a card default.

animation.$why: Colourless transforms and opacity carry over unchanged. cta-pulse does NOT — its keyframes hardcoded rgba(234,88,12,…), the retired Saasify orange, so it must reference the accent channel or it will pulse a dead colour forever. This is the one animation with a colour inside it and it is easy to miss, because the value lives in a keyframes object rather than in the colour map.

retired.$why: Named so nobody restores them from git history thinking they were decisions.
retired.primary-50..950: hugo-saasify-theme vendor filler, laundered into DESIGN.md by a bot commit. primary-950 (#0f1330) was additionally INVENTED by the port to satisfy 38 references that the discarded rename had itself created.
retired.secondary-50..900: Stock Tailwind purple from the same vendor preset. It was doing four separate jobs — muted text, card borders, icon gradients, focus rings — each of which now has a named, measured token.
retired.brand-sage-dark: #A8B88B, invented by the port as a hover accent. FACE expresses hover/selection as the accent border, not a fourth green.
retired.brand-copper: #B87333, invented. Its job was the hero halo's warm stop, which is accent-lift.
retired.brand-ink-raised: #211F1F, invented to name a surface written three ways in layouts. Has a real home now: surface-raised.
retired.neon-orange / neon-green / neon-red / ne: A glow aesthetic both FACE and origin/main retired independently.
retired.rounded-card / rounded-large: 2rem / 2.5rem, Saasify-era. Replaced by the FACE radius scale.
